description: Dev Story's declared vocabulary, in the Garden's dictionary shape.
The validator (engine/games/validation.py) reads this: a flag written
anywhere in the content must appear here or be read somewhere, and a
gate on a flag nothing writes is an error. ending_gallery_unlocked is
the deliberately write-only case -- the CLIENT reads it to unlock the
ending gallery, so no YAML ever tests it; declaring it here is how a
story says 'this write has a reader you cannot see from the data'.
